messages:
Priya (VP Infra): quick follow-up from todays infra segment  dumping a brief Q&A thread on GPU supply, regional quotas, and autoscale/playbook questions. please keep Qs short.

Ben (Sales): customers asking if H100 will be in Dedicated and when they can request pinning for performance demos.

Arjun (Capacity): short answer: initial H100 lots from partners next quarter; Dedicated opt-in about 46 weeks after arrival once telemetry and stress tests pass. will update ETA in the roadmap doc.

Rosa (SRE): for cross-region fallbacks, do we have a hard cap on extra latency we advertise to customers? want to sync with support playbooks.

Priya (VP Infra): were advertising a fallback penalty band: typical +45+150ms depending on region pairing. we wont promise <50ms for cross-region. enterprise customers can be pinned.

Hana (Runtime Eng): any guidance on which quantization profiles are safe to include in warm pools? some of the aggressive int8 variants have 23s cold-start jitter.

Arjun (Capacity): rule-of-thumb: include quant profiles with stable kernel init <12s. anything with >12s cold startup goes to on-demand until we optimize init. well publish a profile table in model-catalog.

Leah (Finance): need a tiny summary: is pre-warmed capacity billed flat or prorated? will the finance team get a spreadsheet for scenario planning?

Priya (VP Infra): pre-warmed nodes are billed as reserved capacity (monthly commit) for Dedicated/reserved customers. for hosted minimal warm pools we absorb a portion and amortize it into the infra surcharge; Tom will share a scenario sheet for finance.

Rosa (SRE): autoscale hysteresis question  we saw flapping yesterday during a priming window. what's the current plan to avoid oscillation?

Arjun (Capacity): implementing a dual-hysteresis: (1) longer cool-down when scale-up occurred in last 10m, (2) queue-depth smoothing window of 60s. also tagging priming traffic so it's ignored up to a soft threshold.

Hana (Runtime Eng): for node preemption (preemptible instances), if a preemptible goes away during a batch, do we retry on the same request or return 503? need for client SDK docs.

Priya (VP Infra): best-effort retry within the router for transient preemption; if retry fails we return 503 with a retry-after header. SDK will expose a client-side retry helper.

Ben (Sales): small ask: can we get a one-paragraph customer-facing blurb about the autoscale fallback behavior and H100 timeline we can use in decks?

Priya (VP Infra): yes  well draft a concise blurb and post it here.

infra-bot: maintenance-bot: scheduled job "priming/apac-buf-v2" started (job-id: jb-194000).

Rosa (SRE): please add a dashboard annotation for priming windows so postmortem noise is reduced.

Arjun (Capacity): will add the annotation and set the priming tag ignore rule to 5% of effective capacity.

Priya (VP Infra): ACTIONS: 1) Arjun to add priming tag + annotation this week. 2) Hana to publish quant-profile startup thresholds into model-catalog. 3) Tom (Platform) to share finance scenario sheet (warm vs on-demand) by Friday. 4) Priya to draft customer blurb for Sales. will add to all-hands notes.

Leah (Finance): thanks  will review sheet and ping if we need further granularity.

Ben (Sales): super helpful  thanks team.

Priya (VP Infra): thanks everyone  small follow-ups here; larger asks via #eng-oncall or RFC. closing after actions are tracked.
